title: Configuration Count Bound
statement:
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, with $k$ work tapes and state set $Q$. For natural numbers $n,E$, if $|Q|+2+9k\le E$, then
\[3(|Q|+1)(n+2)\,3^{k(2(n+2)^E+1)}(2(n+2)^E+1)^k\le 2^{(n+2)^{2E}}.\]
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
